passages.p1: Read the email from Eve to her grandpa. Choose the correct word for each gap. The first one is done for you. Dear Grandpa, This afternoon I went for a [[1]] in the park. The [[2]] were green and full of flowers. I sat down on a wooden [[3]] to rest. Some children were playing on the [[4]]. I gave some bread to the [[5]] on the lake. The park was so [[6]] and beautiful today.
passages.p2: Put the sentences in the correct order. The first sentence is fixed.
passages.p3:
A. It is tempting to dismiss play as something frivolous, a mere break from serious life. Yet scientists who study behaviour increasingly regard it as anything but trivial. Across many species, young animals play in ways that prepare them for the challenges of adulthood. Far from being a waste of time, play appears to be a vital part of how we learn and grow.

B. For children, play is the main engine of development. Through games of make-believe and rough-and-tumble, they practise solving problems, taking turns and managing their feelings. A child building a tower of blocks is quietly learning about balance, planning and persistence. What looks like simple fun is in fact serious work.

C. Board games offer a particularly rich form of structured play. Gathering around a table to roll dice or move pieces brings people together in a shared, face-to-face activity. Unlike screen-based entertainment, these games encourage conversation, laughter and friendly rivalry. In an age of digital distraction, their old-fashioned simplicity feels almost refreshing.

D. Such games also sharpen the mind in enjoyable ways. Many require players to plan ahead, weigh risks and adapt their strategy as circumstances change. Others test memory, vocabulary or quick thinking under pressure. Players exercise valuable mental skills without ever feeling that they are studying.

E. Beyond the brain, board games teach important social lessons. Children and adults alike must learn to follow rules, cope with losing gracefully and celebrate without gloating. Sitting across from an opponent builds patience and an awareness of other people's feelings. These quiet lessons in fair play carry over into everyday life.

F. The appeal of play does not fade with age, even if society sometimes expects it to. Adults who keep playing report lower stress and a stronger sense of connection with those around them. A games night can ease tension and strengthen bonds among friends, families and even colleagues. Remembering how to play may be one secret of staying well.

G. In a busy, results-driven world, the case for play deserves to be taken seriously. Setting aside time simply to enjoy a game is not a guilty indulgence but a genuine investment in our wellbeing. It strengthens our minds, our relationships and our happiness all at once. Perhaps the most grown-up thing we can do is to keep on playing.

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

My sister _____ three languages fluently.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Chủ ngữ "My sister" = ngôi 3 số ít → động từ thêm -s
2. Diễn tả khả năng, sự thật → hiện tại đơn
3. Đáp án: {speaks} — hiện tại đơn ngôi 3
[/tuduy]
[td]Chị gái tôi nói được ba ngôn ngữ trôi chảy.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

A: I enjoy working on challenging projects. B: So _____ I!
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "enjoy" là động từ thường → trợ động từ tương ứng là "do"
2. Cấu trúc đồng tình: So + trợ động từ + S
3. Đáp án: {do} — So do I!
[/tuduy]
[td]A: Tôi thích làm các dự án thử thách. B: Tôi cũng vậy![/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

We _____ to the beach every summer when I was young.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "when I was young" → thói quen trong quá khứ
2. Thời gian xác định quá khứ → past simple
3. Đáp án: {went} — quá khứ đơn
[/tuduy]
[td]Chúng tôi đi biển mỗi mùa hè khi tôi còn nhỏ.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

In those days, my father _____ never eat dinner after eight o'clock.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "In those days" → thói quen trong quá khứ
2. "would + V" diễn tả thói quen lặp lại trong quá khứ (kèm "never")
3. Đáp án: {would} — thói quen quá khứ
[/tuduy]
[td]Ngày xưa, bố tôi không bao giờ ăn tối sau tám giờ.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

Look! The cat _____ on the sofa again.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "Look!" → hành động đang diễn ra ngay lúc nói
2. Đang diễn ra → hiện tại tiếp diễn: is/am/are + V-ing
3. Đáp án: {is sleeping} — hiện tại tiếp diễn
[/tuduy]
[td]Nhìn kìa! Con mèo lại đang ngủ trên ghế sofa.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

She _____ already _____ her lunch.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "already" → hiện tại hoàn thành: has/have + V3
2. Chủ ngữ "She" → has; eat – ate – {eaten}
3. Đáp án: {has / eaten} — hiện tại hoàn thành
[/tuduy]
[td]Cô ấy đã ăn trưa rồi.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He _____ finished cooking when we arrived.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "arrived" = quá khứ đơn → hành động nấu xong xảy ra TRƯỚC đó
2. Hành động trước quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành: had + V3
3. Đáp án: {had} — quá khứ hoàn thành
[/tuduy]
[td]Anh ấy đã nấu xong khi chúng tôi đến.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I _____ to the gym tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "tomorrow morning" → kế hoạch đã sắp xếp trong tương lai
2. Kế hoạch cá nhân đã định → hiện tại tiếp diễn cho tương lai
3. Đáp án: {am going} — present continuous cho kế hoạch
[/tuduy]
[td]Sáng mai tôi sẽ đi tập gym.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

There were _____ than fifty people in the audience last night.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "than" → cần dạng so sánh hơn
2. "people" là danh từ đếm được → dùng "fewer" (không phải "less")
3. Đáp án: {fewer} — so sánh hơn với danh từ đếm được
[/tuduy]
[td]Tối qua có ít hơn năm mươi người trong khán giả.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

We _____ dinner when you called us.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "called" = quá khứ đơn → hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm gọi
2. Đang diễn ra ở quá khứ → past continuous: were + V-ing
3. Đáp án: {were having} — quá khứ tiếp diễn
[/tuduy]
[td]Chúng tôi đang ăn tối khi bạn gọi.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

The children _____ playing football for two hours before it started raining.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "before it started raining" = trước một mốc quá khứ
2. Hành động kéo dài TRƯỚC quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn
3. Đáp án: {had been} — past perfect continuous
[/tuduy]
[td]Bọn trẻ đã chơi bóng được hai tiếng trước khi trời mưa.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

They _____ here since 2015.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "since 2015" → từ quá khứ đến hiện tại
2. Kéo dài đến nay → hiện tại hoàn thành
3. Đáp án: {have lived} — present perfect với since
[/tuduy]
[td]Họ đã sống ở đây từ năm 2015.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

She _____ to the gym every morning before work.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "every morning" → thì hiện tại đơn, thói quen
2. Chủ ngữ "She" (ngôi 3 số ít) → động từ thêm -s
3. Đáp án: {goes} — hiện tại đơn ngôi 3
[/tuduy]
[td]Cô ấy đến phòng gym mỗi sáng trước khi đi làm.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I _____ see you at the party last night. Where were you?
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "last night" → quá khứ đơn
2. Phủ định quá khứ đơn: didn't + V nguyên mẫu
3. Đáp án: {didn't} — phủ định quá khứ đơn
[/tuduy]
[td]Mình không thấy bạn ở bữa tiệc tối qua. Bạn ở đâu vậy?[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

My colleague _____ to interrupt me every five minutes last Tuesday — it was utterly maddening.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện thì quá khứ tiếp diễn với "was" và động từ "trying".
2. Quy tắc: Sử dụng "was constantly trying" để diễn tả hành động kéo dài trong quá khứ.
3. Đáp án: {was constantly trying} — Hành động kéo dài trong quá khứ sử dụng thì quá khứ tiếp diễn.
[/tuduy]
[td]Đồng nghiệp của tôi "đã cố gắng liên tục" làm gián đoạn tôi mỗi năm phút vào thứ Ba tuần trước — điều đó thật sự điên rồ. [/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

She _____ TV when the lights went out.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "went out" = quá khứ đơn → hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm đó
2. Đang diễn ra ở quá khứ → quá khứ tiếp diễn: was + V-ing
3. Đáp án: {was watching} — past continuous bị ngắt bởi past simple
[/tuduy]
[td]Cô ấy đang xem TV thì đèn tắt.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

We _____ a new car next month.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "next month" → kế hoạch đã sắp xếp
2. Kế hoạch xác định → hiện tại tiếp diễn cho tương lai
3. Đáp án: {are buying} — present continuous cho kế hoạch
[/tuduy]
[td]Chúng tôi sẽ mua xe mới tháng tới.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

How long _____ you been waiting here?
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "How long" + "been waiting" → hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn
2. Chủ ngữ "you" → dùng "have"
3. Đáp án: {have} — How long have you been…?
[/tuduy]
[td]Bạn đã đợi ở đây bao lâu rồi?[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He _____ to school by bus every day.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "every day" → thói quen, hiện tại đơn
2. Chủ ngữ "He" ngôi 3 → thêm -es: goes
3. Đáp án: {goes} — hiện tại đơn ngôi 3
[/tuduy]
[td]Anh ấy đi học bằng xe buýt mỗi ngày.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I _____ never _____ sushi before.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "never… before" → kinh nghiệm, hiện tại hoàn thành
2. Chủ ngữ "I" → have + V3 (tried)
3. Đáp án: {have / tried} — hiện tại hoàn thành (kinh nghiệm)
[/tuduy]
[td]Tôi chưa bao giờ thử sushi trước đây.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

This cake tastes _____. Can I have another piece?
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "tastes" là linking verb (động từ nối) → cần tính từ mô tả chủ ngữ
2. Loại: deliciously (adv) · {delicious} (adj) · deliciousness (n)
3. Đáp án: {delicious} — tính từ sau linking verb
[/tuduy]
[td]Bánh này ngon quá. Cho mình thêm miếng nữa được không?[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

She _____ her homework before she went out.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "went out" = quá khứ đơn → hành động làm xong xảy ra TRƯỚC
2. Trước quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành: had + V3
3. Đáp án: {had finished} — past perfect
[/tuduy]
[td]Cô ấy đã làm xong bài tập trước khi ra ngoài.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

He runs much _____ than his older brother.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "than" → cần dạng so sánh hơn
2. "fast" 1 âm tiết → thêm "-er": faster
3. Đáp án: {faster} — so sánh hơn
[/tuduy]
[td]Anh ấy chạy nhanh hơn anh trai nhiều.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

My brother _____ play football, but now he prefers tennis.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "but now he prefers tennis" → thói quen ĐÃ thay đổi
2. Thói quen quá khứ không còn → used to + V nguyên mẫu
3. Đáp án: {used to} — thói quen quá khứ
[/tuduy]
[td]Anh trai tôi từng chơi bóng đá, nhưng giờ anh ấy thích quần vợt hơn.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

What time _____ the film start tonight?
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Hỏi về lịch chiếu (thời gian biểu cố định)
2. Lịch trình → hiện tại đơn; câu hỏi → does + S + V
3. Đáp án: {does} — present simple cho lịch trình
[/tuduy]
[td]Tối nay phim chiếu lúc mấy giờ?[/td]

Writing — Part 2 - Short text

You are a new member of a neighbourhood club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Can you describe where you live?
questions.sampleAnswer: I live in a small flat near the city centre. My neighbourhood is very quiet and friendly, with a lovely park and many shops nearby. I have lived here for three years now, and I really love it.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Mei: Hi, and welcome to the club! How did you hear about us?
questions.sampleAnswer: Thank you for the warm welcome! I heard about the club from my colleague at work. She has been a member for a year and always talks about how friendly and motivating everyone here is.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Tariq: Hello! What do you hope to achieve by joining the club?
questions.sampleAnswer: I hope to become stronger and healthier by exercising regularly. I also want to make new friends who enjoy fitness. Most importantly, I would like to feel more energetic and confident in my daily life.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Elena: The manager is starting a new early-morning fitness class. Would you join it, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I would definitely join the new early-morning class. Exercising before work gives me energy for the whole day. It also means I finish my training early, leaving my evenings free to relax with family.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 4 - Informal and formal emails

Write an email to your friend. Write about your feelings and what you would suggest. Write about 50 words. Recommended time: 10 minutes.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Hi John,
Our Fashion Club is planning an event with famous designers. I think holding a fashion show is a better idea because members can see the clothes in person and enjoy the atmosphere. What do you think?
Best, Hung

questions.content:
Writing — Part 4 - Informal and formal emails

Write an email to the committee. Write about your suggestions for organizing the event. Write 120–150 words. Recommended time: 20 minutes.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Dear Sir,
I am writing to share my opinion about the upcoming event with famous fashion designers. Personally, I believe organizing a fashion show would be the best option. Firstly, members can see the clothing designs directly and appreciate their quality. Secondly, a fashion show creates a more exciting atmosphere and allows members to interact with designers in person. Although an online meeting is more convenient, I think a fashion show offers a more memorable experience. Thank you for considering my suggestion. I hope the club will organize a successful event.
Yours sincerely, Hung

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Tell me about your best friend.
questions.sampleAnswer: My best friend is Lan. We have been friends since primary school. She is kind, funny, and always helps me. We like to go shopping and watch movies together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Describe your home.
questions.sampleAnswer: I live in a small apartment with my family. It has two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a living room. It is not very big but it is cosy and comfortable. I like my home very much.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What is your favourite sport?
questions.sampleAnswer: My favourite sport is badminton. I play it with my friends twice a week. It is fun and good exercise. I am not very good but I enjoy it a lot.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: I see a father and his children having breakfast together. They are sitting at a table and eating. There is bread, fruit, and milk on the table. They look happy and are talking together in the morning.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

What do you usually have for breakfast?
questions.sampleAnswer: For breakfast, I usually eat bread with eggs and drink milk. Sometimes I eat noodles or rice. On weekends, I have a bigger breakfast with my family. I always drink coffee in the morning.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Why is breakfast considered an important meal?
questions.sampleAnswer: Breakfast is important because it gives you energy for the day. After sleeping all night, your body needs food. A good breakfast helps you study and work better. People who skip breakfast feel tired and hungry.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Describe what you see in the pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I see a group of three people working in a garden together. They are planting and watering plants. They look like friends or neighbours. They are working as a team. In the second picture, I see a grandfather and his grandchild in a garden. The old man is teaching the child how to plant. They look happy together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

What are the advantages of gardening with friends compared to gardening with family?
questions.sampleAnswer: Gardening with friends is fun and the work is faster. You can talk and help each other. Gardening with family is special because you teach younger people. Grandparents can pass on knowledge to grandchildren. Both are good ways to spend time.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Do you prefer growing flowers or vegetables? Why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I prefer growing vegetables because I can eat them. It is useful and healthy. I like fresh vegetables from my garden. But flowers are beautiful too. Some people like flowers because they make the garden colourful.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

Tell me about a time when you explored nature.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Last summer, I went to a national park with my family. We walked through a forest and climbed a small mountain. The nature there was very beautiful. We spent the whole day outside.
We saw many trees, flowers, and birds. There was a beautiful waterfall and a clear river. We took many photos and had a picnic near the river. We also swam in the cool water. It was a wonderful day.
Yes, I think spending time in nature is very good for people. Nature helps us relax and feel calm. The fresh air is good for our health. When we are in nature, we forget our stress and problems. Everyone should spend more time outside.
